title: PeerRateLimiter HashMap never evicted — unbounded memory per IP
description: transit/src/peering/rate_limit.rs: buckets: HashMap<String, TokenBucket> is populated on first connection from each IP and never pruned. A peer that connects once and disconnects leaves an entry forever. A scanner hitting the transit daemon from N unique addresses leaks N bucket allocations with no bound. → In production peering with thousands of short-lived peers, this becomes a slow memory leak. Fix: LRU eviction or a periodic cleanup pass; alternatively, only create buckets for IPs that have been seen more than once.
